newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian troops seize opium on Tajik-Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Russian troops seize opium on Tajik-Afghan border.

text.p: An Afghan trying to smuggle 35 kg (75 pounds) of opium across the Pyandzh River from Afghanistan to Tajikistan was detained by Russian border troops on Monday, the Russian military said.

"The man tried to cross the Pyandzh in an inflatable dinghy," a spokesman for Russia's Federal Border Service told Reuters in the Tajik capital Dushanbe. "He had two bags containing 35 kg of raw opium."

About 20,000 Russian troops are deployed in the ex-Soviet state to guard the mountainous frontier and carry out peace-keeping duties in the country, now emerging tentatively from a four-year civil war.
The spokesman said Russian border guards have seized more than 600 kg (1200 pounds) of opium this year.
